body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Control4, a leader in affordable IP-based home control and entertainment systems, announced the names of leading companies participating in the Control4 Partner Pavilion at the 2009 Consumer Electronics Show.
The pavilion partners demonstrate how life is better for people when consumer electronics and home systems work seamlessly together utilizing the Control4 platform.

Each partner will host a kiosk in the pavilion that highlights its specific solutions. CES attendees will be able to see firsthand the interoperability and integration between partner products like HDTVs, receivers, door locks and the Control4 platform.

Meanwhile, Control4 is the first company to make whole-home automation a practical option for any residence. The company makes everyday life easier by providing one-touch control of both new and existing electronic systems in the home.
